text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I don't want to!
I'm gonna brush my teeth thoroughly and properly every single day!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Rewinding time to a few hours ago.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
!? !?
M-My tooth hurts...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly had her let me check inside her mouth,
...but there were no signs of a cavity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, Shinko Windy is an Umamusume who takes great care of her teeth.
Every day, she brushes them slowly and thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I only took one tiny bite of ice cream...
What happened to my precious, precious teeeeth?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed her to the dentist, and as it turned out...
Ironically, brushing her teeth for too long had caused
a mild case of tooth sensitivity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It will heal on its own after a while, but just to be safe,
it's best to reconsider her brushing routine.
I was trying to persuade her of this, but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I will not make it shorter!
What if you get cavities because of that?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the idea that "failing to brush thoroughly = cavities"
has left a strong impression on her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... I have an idea of what's going on.
You seem to be in a bit of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
I have a secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For them to go as far as calling it a “secret plan,” it must be something extraordinary. As I watched with bated breath—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Look, Windy-san.
Some suuuper delicious ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*.
Ahh, so yummy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want Windy-san to eat some too, but...
Ah, it'll sting your teeth, won't it?
Guess you can't eat it then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you just adjust your brushing time a little,
maybe you'll be able to eat it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was unexpectedly normal.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Fine by me!
Getting a cavity would be way worse~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gaaahn!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please wait!
This is so frustrating! Just one more chance~!
I still have a secret plan up my sleeve!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "We need to explain the terror of ‘hypersensitivity’ in a way that's easy to understand!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It can lead to cavities and gum disease, so if you explain it properly, I'm sure they'll find the motivation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
O-Or, look at this!
Devil Transformation Stickers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They're stickers shaped like thorns and scars that you can stick on your body to play with! Maybe we could use them as rewards!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it boils down to either explaining it in simple terms
or bribing them with reward stickers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...It's far too ordinary to call a 'secret plan', but I feel like we can expect decent results from it nonetheless."
choice_data_list: Explain it in simple terms and get them motivated.
Promise to give a sticker as a reward

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went looking for Shinko Windy after she ran off,
I found her lying low behind the school building.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then please play along
with my little skit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*
Man, tooth sensitivity is terrifying, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gradually, even the slightest stimulus becomes unbearable,
and you won't even be able to enjoy brushing your teeth.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that, there's always the possibility
you'll end up with a painful cavity, you know~"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A... A c-cavity...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Windy-san, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I must decide on tooth-brushing time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, she could be seen timing her toothbrushing with a stopwatch—and soon enough, her tooth sensitivity was cured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To make a promise to give her the stickers,
I went looking for the Shinko Windy who ran off...
and found her hiding behind the stairs."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr!
When I say no, I mean nooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —With that, I pull up and show the sticker that Matikanetannhauser told me about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh...
What is this amazingly cool sticker...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Fangs and spikes, wings and horns!
It looks suuuper villainous~!!"
choice_data_list: I'll give it to you if you can set a specific time to brush your teeth.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th-That's not fair~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, perhaps thanks to the stickers,
she started listening properly—"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rawr! Awesome, right? Scary, right? I'm a demon, rawr!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!
What is this! That's super scary!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later on, her tooth sensitivity had completely healed, and I was even able to see her gleefully playing with the stickers.
